title: Sentences used in the speech-to-song illusion: Comparisons of acoustic vowel space
exclusion_reason: EXCLUDE: although the study manually segmented words/phonemes/vowels in Praat and derived vowel-formant measures, the underlying speech recordings were assembled from pre-existing audiobook and UvA Music Cognition stimuli rather than primary recordings collected for this study. This is secondary reuse/third-party media under the database policy.
evidence: Article methods report manual segmentation, but materials state that the 77 analyzed spoken sentences derive from prior speech-to-song stimulus corpora including audiobooks; therefore the new annotations do not satisfy the primary-recording criterion for this database.
